name: release-evidence
title: Release evidence pack
for_each: select id,name from runs order by name

sections.title: Run decision
sections.note: A test report for human review. This does not approve or deploy a release.

sections.title: Checks
sections.sql: select title,version,priority,status,evidence,actor,open_defects from execution_status where run_id=$1 order by title

sections.title: Full result history
sections.sql: select e.title,x.status,x.evidence,x.note,x.actor,x.created_at from results x join execution_status e on e.id=x.run_case_id where e.run_id=$1 order by x.seq

name: defect-follow-up
title: Defect follow-up
for_each: select id,title as name from defects order by title

sections.title: Related execution
sections.sql: select e.run,e.build,e.environment,e.title,e.status,e.evidence from execution_status e join defects d on d.run_case_id=e.id where d.id=$1

name: test-data-review
title: Test-data review record
for_each: select id,name from projects order by name

sections.title: Purpose and retention
sections.sql: select name,owner,data_review_due,retention_note from projects where id=$1
sections.note: Keep synthetic test records. Review linked evidence for personal information before sharing.

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from activity where record_id=$1 order by created_at
